objective: Train an update-specific LoRAcle that generalizes and reliably outperforms the released LoRAcle on smaller, single-step weight updates. Positive results must be earned on untouched evaluation, never by redefining success or suppressing failures.
status: Development protocol; implementation and training-only preflight pending. No new scientific run launched.
first_study: Same pinned Qwen3-14B and released interpreter. Independent one-step rank16 all-seven-module LoRA AdamW updates, starting from the same effective base function with split-disjoint adapter initializations. Four documents per update, LR0.0002, clip1, weight decay0, fresh optimizer per independent update. This is actual optimizer-update interpretation, not a raw-gradient or arbitrary-state claim.
tasks: 32 compositions: format plain/bullets/numbered/json; case lower/upper; order original/reverse/alphabetical/length. For every label list the four orders must differ. Component operations are known in training, entire compositions are held out. Generalization means novel compositions, words, exact prompts, batches and adapter initializations. It does not yet establish novel-operation or arbitrary-checkpoint generalization.
splits: Composition residue (format_index+order_index+case_index)%4: 0/1 training16; 2 development8; 3 reserved test8. Training16 independent batches/composition=256 updates, development8/composition=64, reserved test16/composition=128. Four split-disjoint initialization seeds and separate nonce-label vocabularies and prompt templates. Reserved test is not collected or exposed until one method is selected and frozen. First confirmation will use an additionally frozen new draw of held-out compositions and fresh seeds/data, with no tuning after reading it.
effect_labels: For each update score all32 reference response patterns on4 separate probe prompts before and after the update, same original EOS and per-answer mean completion CE. Center each pattern loss change by the mean change across32 patterns. Label the pattern with the greatest relative likelihood improvement; no-change if the span of loss changes is below0.02 nats/token. Preserve complete profiles, margins and absolute changes. Training task labels never substitute for measured effects. These finite-reference loss contrasts are not free-generation effects.
interpreter_input: Same released4480x5120 direction-token representation and rank-first prefix for adapted and unchanged LoRAcle; add physical update norm as text to both. All32 patterns and no-change appear as numbered choices, with choice order independently shuffled per case. Neither training examples, source composition label nor measured effects appear in interpreter inputs. Primary forced-choice likelihood at the next number token avoids penalizing unadapted prose formatting.
training: Warm-start the pinned released rank256 interpreter. Supervised fine-tuning on training updates and measured labels only. Fixed first development recipe3 epochs, LR0.00003, effective batch4, clipping1, AdamW weight decay0.01, 5% linear warmup. Save all epochs. Choose only on the separate development split. Resource feasibility can be repaired on training-only preflight before launch, with all failed settings preserved. Exact recipe must be frozen in the run plan.
references: Unchanged released LoRAcle on identical inputs and constrained-choice scoring; training-only most-common label baseline; simple learned update-feature predictor. A matched shuffled-weight-input evaluation tests whether the interpreter uses the update instead of answer priors. Zero updates are explicit controls and excluded from primary nonzero-update accuracy.
development_goals: Evaluate all updates. Strong target: at least70% exact measured-effect category accuracy, at least20 percentage points over unchanged LoRAcle, at least80% of updates above the0.02 effect-span floor, and at least90% zero-control accuracy. Report per-axis correctness, all32 patterns, every held-out composition/seed, top-two ambiguity and raw loss profiles. No exclusion of difficult/weak cases from primary denominator.
confirmation_requirements: Before first reserved-test evaluation, freeze exact selected method, source/model/input hashes, all endpoints, sample counts and inference procedure. Strong-positive claim requires fresh held-out confirmation: exact accuracy>=70%, advantage>=20pp, and simultaneous lower confidence bounds above60% accuracy and10pp advantage. Paired cluster resampling over held-out composition and seed, with97.5% marginal intervals for the two primary quantities; include a paired exact method-swap test by composition. All controls/failure cases must be shown. A development-only win is not completion.
iteration_policy: Develop using training/development evidence. Preserve every failed recipe and complete result. Do not revisit a previously read test set as untouched evidence; any subsequent selected method needs a new frozen evaluation. No result-dependent stopping within a fixed run. This replaces the old no-further-experiment restriction only for the newly authorized active goal.
execution: Only the three user-supplied machines, currently H10068 for new work. No downloads, rentals, people messages or new agents. Remote heavy outputs stay remote. Each launched phase has an immutable12-hour deadline with no automatic resume; separate legitimate phases receive their own first-launch deadlines. Source/input manifests, bit-exact restores, masks, all-choice scoring and optimizer invariance require tests and training-only GPU preflight. No scientific evaluation until those pass.
reporting: Concise HTML reports and scientific figures with actual input/output examples, code and compact provenance committed as Nicole Ma. README remains empty, no Markdown documentation. Keep goal active until generalization and superiority are verified; no guarantee that the hypothesis is true.
